Monte Sacro — Rome, Italy

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

Monte Sacro is the dense historic core of the wider Montesacro district, centered on Piazza Sempione, mixing residential blocks with local shops. In August 2026, press reported that a woman was struck with a broken bottle by a man described as mentally disturbed, who remained at large as of the report - an isolated but genuinely documented violent incident. Beyond that, coverage of the area is largely ordinary neighborhood life, with daytime appearing calm and no other significant safety concerns found in recent searches.
